study type: Planned supplemental analysis of a randomized clinical trial (cross-sectional analysis at baseline)
cohort: The participants were 186 women with moderate to severe fecal incontinence.
finding: Overall, there was no association between FI severity and dietary fat/fiber intake, though a weak negative correlation was found between the number of FI-free days and total fat intake.
cross-section timing: At baseline of a randomized clinical trial
